description: Test specifications for browser 'beforeunload' event handling in Playwright, covering scenarios like closing pages, handling dialogs, and navigating away with 'beforeunload' handlers.

methods.name: should close browser with beforeunload page
methods.description: Test that verifies the browser closes correctly when a page with a 'beforeunload' handler is involved.

methods.name: should close browsercontext with beforeunload page
methods.description: Test that verifies a browser context is closed correctly with a page having 'beforeunload' handlers.

methods.name: should be able to navigate away from page with beforeunload
methods.description: Test that navigation away from a page with 'beforeunload' handlers behaves correctly.

methods.name: should close page with beforeunload listener
methods.description: Test that a page with 'beforeunload' event listeners closes successfully.

methods.name: should run beforeunload if asked for @smoke
methods.description: Test that 'beforeunload' dialogs run and can be accepted or dismissed.

methods.name: should access page after beforeunload
methods.description: Test that page properties can still be accessed after 'beforeunload' dialogs.

methods.name: should not stall on evaluate when dismissing beforeunload
methods.description: Ensures evaluation stalls do not occur when dismissing 'beforeunload' dialogs.

methods.name: should not stall on click when dismissing beforeunload
methods.description: Checks that clicking links related to 'beforeunload' handlers does not cause stalls.

methods.name: should support dismissing the dialog multiple times
methods.description: Verifies dismissing multiple dialogs works as expected.

methods.name: should support closing the page after a previous dismiss
methods.description: Tests closing a page after dismissing a 'beforeunload' dialog.

methods.name: should support closing the page via a subsequent onbeforeunload dialog
methods.description: Verifies closing a page via a 'beforeunload' dialog acceptance.
